title: Rewards Allowance Set Against the Charges in a Telephone Payment on an Auto Loan
content:
An allowance is set against the charges a telephone payment on a loan of the Auto Loans line is asked to clear. Its size is read from the borrower's Personal Credit Cards account: the unredeemed reward points it carries, and the purchases posted to it in the last three months.

| Unredeemed reward points on the card | Card purchases posted in the last three months | Charge allowance |
|---|---|---|
| At least 25000 | At least 6 | 20.00 |
| At least 5000, with either reading short of the row above | At least 3, with either reading short of the row above | 10.00 |
| Any other reading | Any other reading | 0.00 |

The charge allowance is 20.00 where the borrower's card carries at least 25000 unredeemed reward points and at least 6 card purchases have posted in the last three months.

It is 10.00 where that card carries at least 5000 unredeemed reward points and at least 3 card purchases have posted in the last three months, while either those points fall short of 25000 or those purchases fall short of 6.

It is 0.00 for every other borrower.

## The two readings

The points reading is the unredeemed reward balance standing on the borrower's active card account in the Personal Credit Cards line. The purchase reading is a count of purchases posted to that card over the three months ending today, not a sum of their amounts.

## The allowance at the edge of each row

A card carrying 25000 points with 5 purchases in the last three months takes 10.00, since the purchases fall short of 6 while both middle-row readings are met.

A card carrying 4999 points takes 0.00 whatever its purchase count.

A card carrying 30000 points with 6 purchases takes 20.00.
